'''Vestil Kwass''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] lieutenant of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] in the [[Karthakk system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vestil Kwass appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vestil Kwass was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
